items.name: SCS1 Almaty Open Air 2019
items.information: Летние соревнования будут проводиться на открытом воздухе на территории жилого комплекса возле Школы спидкубинга. Будут расставлены шатры защищающие участников от солнца и дождя. На соревнования необходимо взять с собой солнцезащитный крем и головоломки, которые вы будете собирать. На территории есть детская площадка и футбольное поле, где можно будет поиграть (мячи не предоставляем). Официальная церемония открытия состоится 20 июля 2019 года в 10:15. За участие всем будут выданы крутые памятные медали, а за призовые места во всех дисциплинах предусмотрены призы и медали! Summer competitions will be held outdoors in a residential complex near the School of speedcubing. Tents will be placed to protect participants from the sun and rain. Please take with you sunscreen and puzzles that you are going to solve. Onsite there is a children playground and a football field where you can play (balls are not provided) The official opening ceremony will take place on 20 July 2019 at 10:15. For participation everyone will be given a cool commemorative medals and for taking a podium of every event there are prizes and medals!

items.name: GLS Cup II 2019
items.information: GLS Cup 2019 is a cycle of 6 official WCA competition in Gdańsk (Northern Poland). From many years we cooperate with hotel Novotel Marina. Thanks to this we can provide the highest standard of cubing environment. Elegant ferniture, profesional audiosystem and perfect lighting. For ourdisposal we have beautiful garden with beach access. Moreover we have dedicated restaurant and foyer as a rest area. GLS League is connection of 6 competition. We have big rankings system. - General classification of all events - 3x3x3 classification for kids, - 3x3x3 for parents At the main venue we have big rollup with the names of GLS record holders. It is our tradition to refresh the names after each record. After the first day we organise cubers integration. Next to the hotel we have parking area and shop. If you want to join us, you are most welcome!

items.information: Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2019! Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 8 seconds or 5 minutes. This year will be a 4 day competition, hosting all 18 WCA events. If you are not competiting in 3x3x3 FMC, 5x5x5, 6x6x6, 7x7x7, 3x3x3 with Feet, Clock or Megaminx, there is no need to be present in Huskvarna on Thursday or Friday. Please read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, however only competitors representing Sweden are eligeble for medals, prize money and the Swedish Champion titles. ----- Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2019! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 8 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 4-dagarstävling med alla 18 WCA-grenar. Om du inte tänker delta i 3x3x3 FMC, 5x5x5, 6x6x6, 7x7x7, 3x3x3 med fötterna, Clock eller Megaminx så behöver du inte vara på plats i Huskvarna under torsdagen eller fredagen. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, prispengar och titeln Svensk Mästare.

items.information: Welcome to this blind events only competition in Tullinge, just outside Stockholm! We will only have blindsolving events at this competition. However, registration is free and the time-limits are lenient, so we would like to see many of you gathered for this competition in April! Please read through all the tabs on this page to get all the information you need for this competition. The main event of this competition is **3x3x3 Blindfolded**. If you have any further questions, feel free to contact the organizers using the contact information on this page. We are not allowed to wear outside shoes inside the venue, and the floor tend to get a bit cold as it is in a basement. Therefore, a good tip is to bring some slippers or inside shoes to keep your feet warm during the day. ----- Varmt välkomna till denna tävling med bara blindgrenar i Tullinge, strax utanför Stockholm! Vi kommer bara ha blindgrenar på denna tävling. Det är dock gratis att delta och alla time-limits är generöst satta, så vi hoppas se många av er på denna tävling i april! Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att få all information om denna tävling. Tävlingens huvudgren är **3x3x3 med Ögonbindel** Om du har ytterligare frågor så går det bra att kontakta arrangörerna genom kontaktinformationen på denna sida. Det är inte tillåtet att ha på sig utomhusskor inne i tävlingslokalen och golvet tenderar och bli ganska kallt då lokalen ligger i en källare. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. items.information: The main event of this competition is 3x3 Fewest Moves. -We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. You may eat in the cafeteria next door.There are a few restaurants within a ten minute drive. -Live results will be posted on cubecomps.com. -All proceeds from the competition will be donated to the No Place for Hate® club of Emmaus High School. Proceeds will not be donated to ADL directly. -CubeDepot will sponsor the competition and will be a vendor! **A local newspaper photographer will be taking pictures of the competition. If you would not like to have your picture taken, please let us know.** **Please observe silence during FMC and blindfold events.** **This competition will not be holding the famous 3x3 speedsolve event. We still encourage newer competitors to try out other events!**

items.information: Een compleet weekend met 2 overnachtingen, maaltijden, snacks en natuurlijk een vol wedstrijdprogramma. Bezoekers betalen geen bijdrage, maar kunnen geen gebruik maken van het eten en drinken. A complete weekend with 2 overnight stays, meals, snacks and a complete competition programma. Before you register, please read the detailed information on the website of [Speedcubing Nederland](http://www.kubuswedstrijden.nl/kubusweekend2019). There is a limited number of beds available for guests. Guests will pay the same price as competitors. Это означает что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1-2 недели до соревнований вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и спам. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. If a participant under 18 years old attends the competition without adult, he must have written application from parents or legal guardians that they are responsible for their child. 2. Puzzles used in competitions must have distinctive marks by which the owner can easily identify them (for example, scratched initials or the name on the inside of the removable cover) ** After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you did not pay the fee, then approximately 1-2 weeks before the competition you will receive an email with a reminder to pay a fee to confirm your participation. Be sure to check your box and spam. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but it was not confirmed within 2 business days, contact the organizers immediately (not counting the weekend). On the day of the competition, the participant and the guest need to have an identity document.

items.name: Fewest Moves Christmas 2018
items.information: Den eneste disciplin der vil blive afholdt til denne konkurrence er 3x3x3 i Færrest Træk! Der vil være pauser mellem de tre forsøg, hvor vi kan have noget julesjov. Vi vil lave pakkeleg, hvor det er muligt at deltage, hvis man medbringer en lille gave. Efter konkurrencen vil det være muligt at blive og hygge til klokken 20:00. Frokost og julesnacks vil blive serveret i løbet af dagen og er en del af detagergebyret. Det vil også være muligt at få aftensmad, men det vil koste ekstra :) ____ The only event which will be held at this competition is 3x3x3 Fewest Moves! There will be breaks between the attempts where we can have some Christmas fun. One of these activities will be "Pakkeleg" where you can bring a small gift if you wish to participate. After the competition it will be possible to stay for hygge until 20:00. Lunch and Christmas snacks will be provided in the registration fee. Dinner is optional and will cost extra :)

items.information: * This is not your normal competition. If you have not competed before, you are welcome to attend, but this is not the best competition for your first experience. The competition is open to spectators at no charge. * Please be quiet. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund. * Competitors should expect to judge. Depending on the number of competitors who enter and the expected times per BLD attempt, the organisation team will schedule everyone's individual BLD attempts to give the competition a nice, clear structure. When you are not scheduled to compete (this includes FMCers), please be available to judge BLD attempts. IMPORTANT! In accordance with articles 2g, 2k, and 2l, competitors that fail to abide by the specified WCA regulations shall be disqualified, at the discretion of the WCA delegate. For further information, please send an email to [Wilson Alvis](mailto:walvisc54@gmail.com).

items.information: Quinnipiac University will host its first official WCA competition this September! We are planning a competition with a relaxed but engaging and social atmosphere, that will hopefully give the Connecticut cubing community a chance to connect. The theme of this competition is breadth rather than depth. Our events will sample a variety of puzzle categories, from larger cubes (4x4) and different solving approaches (One-Handed, Blindfolded, Fewest Moves), to puzzles of different shapes (Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1). All events except the traditional 3x3 speedsolve will be single rounds; Fewest Moves in particular will consist of **one** hour-long attempt. Family, friends, and guests are welcome, but we ask competitors to let us know the number of people attending on their registration forms. The parking lot in front of the venue should be free of charge, but there are no guarantees if that particular lot reaches capacity. We look forward to seeing you in September!

items.information: Registration Fee: There is a **$20** registration fee for the event, payable through the WCA Stripe payment system. Please note that even after payment, registrations need to be manually approved before appearing on the registration list, so you may still not be fully confirmed immediately after payment. Please keep an eye out for the e-mail saying you have been approved. Registration is on a first-come first-serve and the same will go for the waitlist once registration fills up. Please do not register unless you intend on competing as it will open up a spot for another competitor who does intend on competing. **We will only be accepting online payment at this competition. If you have any issues with this, please contact us!** There is a **25 competitor limit** to the competition. Please register as soon as possible if you plan on coming! Registration closes at the end of the day on July 7th. We will grant refunds to those who let us know by July 7th, but no refunds are granted after that date. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at [CubingUSA's Competitor Tutorial](https://www.cubingusa.com/ctutorial.php). Join the PNW Facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they are announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area! items.information: Dear competitors and guests! 1. The official opening ceremony will be held on June 7, 2018 at 7 pm. According to our idea, it will be held at the main square of the city. For the ceremony we will prepare a special show with the famous speedcubers. In this regard, we recommend arriving in the city no later than 12.00 hours on June 7. 2. The base fee allows to compete in 2x2x2 Cube, 3x3x3 Cube, Skewb, Pyraminx and Clock. For any other event you will need to pay additionally 1000 KZT per event. 3. The winner of each event will receive a prize! =========== Барлық қатысушылар мен қонақтардың назарына !!! 1. Ресми ашылу 2018 жылдың 7 маусымында сағат 19.00-де өтеді, қаланың орталық алаңында өтеді. Салтанатты ашылу рәсімі үшін атақты спидкуберлер қатысуымен шоу-бағдарлама дайындалады. Осыған байланысты біз 7-маусымда сағат 12.00-ден кешіктірмей қалаға келуді ұсынамыз. 2. Негізгі сыйақы 2x2x2 куб, 3x3x3 куб, Skewb, Pyraminx және Clock бойынша бәсекелесуге мүмкіндік береді. Кез-келген басқа іс-шараға қосымша бір оқиға үшін 1000 теңге төлеуге тура келеді. 3. Әр жарыстың жеңімпазы жүлде алады. =========== Дополнительная информация: Внимание всем участникам и гостям!!! 1. Официальная церемония открытия, состоится 7 июня 2018 года в 19.00 ч. По нашей задумке она будет проходить на главной площади города. Для церемонии будет подготовлена специальная шоу программа с участием именитых спидкуберов. В связи с этим рекомендуем прибыть в город не позднее 12.00 часов 7 июня. 2. Регистрационный взнос позволяет принять участие в дисциплинах: 2х2, Rubik's Cube, Skweb, Piraminx, Clock. Для участия в других дисциплинах необходимо оплатить дополнительный взнос по 1000 тенге за каждую дисциплину. 3. За первое место во всех дисциплинах предусмотрены призы

items.information: This competition will take place on the 6th of June and it is the first competition ever in Heimaey! To get to the island you need to go with a ferry called Herjólfur. The harbor is called Landeyjahöfn and is ~2 hours away from Reykjavík. It is possible to take a bus from there. You can order tickets to the ferry here - https://www.seatours.is/ . You can check out booking.com or airbnb.com for information about hotels and other places to stay in over night. Our goal with the schedule is to have events that were not held at Icelandic nationals. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Þetta mót verður haldið 6. júni og er það fyrsta mótið á Heimaey frá upphafi! Til þess að komast á eyjuna þarft þú að fara með ferjunni Herjólfi. Hann er staðsettur í Landeyjahöfn og er u.þ.b. tveggja klukkustunda keyrsla frá Reykjavík til Landeyjahafnar. Hægt er að taka strætó á milli staða. Hér getur þú pantað miða í Herjólf - https://www.saeferdir.is/ferdir-i-bodi/vestmannaeyjar/ Þú getur kíkt á booking.com / airbnb.com fyrir upplýsingar um hótel eða aðra gistingu í Vestmannaeyjum.

items.information: Mind Games 2017 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill, but there is a competitor limit of 60 people (FMC will have a limit of 25 competitors), due to venue constraints. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

Tjek rejseplanen.dk Regelsæt Denne konkurrence følger WCA regelsættet, det er derfor forventet at alle deltager er bekendt med dette. Alle deltagere er derfor også underforstået med at deres resultater vil blive publiceret på WCA's hjemmeside, inklusiv navn, nationalitet og køn. Betalingspolitik Aflysning: Hvis du tilmelder dig konkurrencen, men du ikke kan komme og du informerer os via e-mail, før den 3. juni, 2016 vil vi overføre halvdelen af ​​den betalte afgift tilbage. Redigering af registrering: tilføje events: Skriv en mail med hvilke events du vil tilføje før 3. juni 2016. Redigering registrering: fjerne events: Skriv en mail med hvilke events du vil fjernes fra før 3. juni 2016. Registreringer uden betalinger: De registreringer uden betaling, vil blive slettet efter tilmeldingsfristen. (3. juni 2016.) Acceptering af registreringer: Vi betragter en registrering for gyldig, når registreringen er færdig, og tilmeldingsgebyret er betalt. Vi vil først acceptere tilmeldingen efter begge disse betingelser er opfyldt. Overnatning Plads til 70 personer til overnatning på venue. Det er først til mølle princippet, og det er gratis. Kontakt Camilla (fam.nielsson@gmail.com ) Indkvartering kan fra fredag aften. Man kan overnatte fra fredag til søndag.

items.name: Selandia Open 2016
items.information: Information DK Der vil være skilte på hoveddøren, og dørene åbner kl. 9:30. Transport: Der er parkeringspladser ved venuen. Det er nemt at komme til venuen ved offentlig transport da der er mange togforbindelser til Slagelse St. Nærmere informationer kan findes på rejseplanen.dk, hvor destinationen kan sættes til stoppestedet 'Selandia'. Der er ca. 20 minutters gang fra Slagelse St. Mad: Der ligger en McDonald's og Burger King 2 km fra gymnasiet, og en Lidl 600 m fra gymnasiet. Overnatning: Det er ikke muligt at overnatte på venue. Information EN Follow the signs at the main entrance. The venue will open at 9 AM. Transport: There are parking spots at the venue. It is easy to commute to the venue by public transport, as many trains stop in Slagelse. You can take a train directly from the train station at Copenhagen Airport to Slagelse St., or a train from Copenhagen Airport to Copenhagen Central Station, and then a train to Slagelse St. Further information can be found on rejseplanen.dk, where the destination can be set to the bus stop 'Selandia' or Slagelse St. The walk from Slagelse St. to the venue is around 20 minutes. Food: There is a McDonald's and Burger King 2 km from the venue, and a grocery store 600 m from the venue. Accommodation: It is not possible to sleep at the venue, but there are following options: Danhostel Slagelse (1,5 km) (http://danhostel-slagelse.dk/) Hotel Frederik d.II (2,1 km) (http://www.fr2.dk/) Hotel Antvorskov (3,2 km) (http://www.hotelantvorskov.dk/en/)
